recognize_zh: 右側肝臟竇狀隙內有許多 CD14 陽性的單核球/巨噬細胞沿竇壁分布，左側較密的浸潤區則多為弱陽性或陰性；顯示 JMML 浸潤中含單核球系成分，但要注意庫佛氏細胞（Kupffer cells）本身也表現 CD14。
features: Hepatocyte plates with sinusoids containing CD14-positive cells (membranous/cytoplasmic staining)
CD14-positive cells outline and fill sinusoids on the right side of the field
Denser cellular infiltrate on the left (portal/periportal area) is largely CD14-negative or weak
Kupffer cells normally express CD14, limiting quantification of neoplastic monocytes
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD14 on a liver section shows numerous CD14-positive cells within the sinusoids, outlining the hepatocyte plates on the right side of the field. A denser mononuclear infiltrate on the left, likely periportal, is largely negative to weakly positive, indicating a mixed population. Hepatocytes are negative. Because resident Kupffer cells also express CD14, the stain supports a monocytic component within the sinusoidal infiltrate but does not by itself quantify neoplastic monocytes; in context, findings are consistent with hepatic involvement by juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: CD14+ sinusoidal lining cells are present but not accompanied by a dense immature myelomonocytic and erythroid infiltrate.
Shows sheets of monoblasts/promonocytes with a high blast count rather than a mixed maturing infiltrate with rare CD34+ cells.
CD68/CD163+ histiocytes show hemophagocytosis, lacking a myeloproliferative background.
